scripts.setup: npm run setup:deps && npm run setup:env
scripts.setup:deps: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup:env: node -e "for (const f of ['.env', 'backend/.env']) require('fs').existsSync(f) || require('fs').copyFileSync(f + '.example', f)"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run test:ci
